summary: Loads a compiled C++ plugin to implement a custom CHOP operator inside TouchDesigner.
key_concepts: Creates custom CHOP operators by loading a compiled plugin written with TouchDesigner's C++ plugin API.
Plugin Path selects the binary to load, while Re-Init deletes the current plugin class instance and creates a new one.
Unload Plugin deletes the plugin class instance and unloads the binary when the parameter goes above 1.
If multiple CPlusPlus CHOPs load the same plugin, every instance must unload it before the plugin file is released.
The official page points to Write a CPlusPlus Plugin and the C++ category for plugin API contracts and examples.
Common CHOP controls still apply, including Time Slice, Scope, Sample Rate Match, export, and rename parameters.

key_params.name: reinit
key_params.note: Recreate the plugin class instance while on

key_params.note: Delete the plugin class instance and unload the plugin when above 1

key_params.name: srselect
key_params.note: Sample-rate match behavior for conflicting input rates

common_gotchas: Plugin binaries are platform, compiler, and TouchDesigner SDK specific; validate availability before planning around them.
Re-init deletes and recreates the plugin class instance, which can reset plugin-side state.
If multiple CPlusPlus CHOPs load the same plugin, all must unload it before the file is released.
A crashing plugin can destabilize the TouchDesigner process, so prefer dry-run availability checks before loading unknown binaries.
Use the official C++ plugin examples and Write a CPlusPlus Plugin guide for API contracts.
